title: Jungle Valley Land Near Tegallalang
description: Fifteen ares dropping gently toward a jungle river valley north of Ubud, minutes from the Tegallalang terraces. The land is currently zoned agricultural: development requires the aspect-and-setback pathway used for eco-retreats in this area, which our legal team scopes as part of due diligence. Priced accordingly — this is the trade-off that makes the entry price a fraction of tourism-zoned Ubud land.
investmentNote: Wellness and retreat operators actively seek exactly this profile: river, jungle, seclusion, Tegallalang proximity. Structured correctly, a retreat concept here targets premium nightly rates against one of the lowest land bases in the catalog. Zoning pathway must be confirmed before commitment — we walk you through it.
